name: falsePositiveFreeValidationPercentage
definition: The percentage of open weakness series that NodeZero exploit-verified (is_one_click_verify true) and that are not annotated as a false positive.
population: Weakness series with status OPEN in the weakness series page for one NodeZero tenant; the denominator is that set, the numerator the ones with is_one_click_verify true and no false-positive annotation.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A passing percentage needs open series that report is_one_click_verify and annotation_status; a series missing either counts as unvalidated, so it lowers the figure and never raises it.

changeLog.change: Registered so the Horizon3 NodeZero transforms can emit it; the meaning is what the transform reads, stated precisely. Unverified fields are named in notes.

notes: Only the NodeZero transform emits this key today. Field names are as that transform reads them; they were not live-verified against a NodeZero tenant, so the key stays proposed at V0 with the owner not yet named. With no open series the transform returns 0.0 with dataCollection status success, not null; that departs from the not-measured rule and is not yet corrected, so no requirement should gate on this key until it is.
